repos_data.description: Open-source text-to-SQL engine you tune and measure on your own database

repo_meta_data.description: Text-to-SQL access control: schema selection that gives the LLM only the tables the caller is allowed to read. Row-level-security-aware table pruning for LangChain, MCP and any SQL agent. Postgres, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server. 75% fewer prompt tokens.
